title: With nothing open on the date, the report says so
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Your organization had no open bill or vendor credit on 1 January 2000.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to 1 January 2000.
  4. Read the message in the table.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results."

Why this matters: An empty report must explain itself.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/ReportingModel.ts:115; app/src/components/ts/reporting/ReportingModel.ts:125; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:13-24. V1 code, quoted: `REPORT_EMPTY_TITLE = 'No record matches these filters'; REPORT_EMPTY_SUBTITLE = 'Try changing filters to widen your results.'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-062) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
